title: Correct time expression
description: Essential: The response must give the time of flight as t = sqrt(2h/g).

title: Correct velocity expression
description: Essential: The response must give the initial speed as v0 = d * sqrt(g/(2h)).

title: Correct flow rate expression
description: Essential: The response must give the volume flow rate as Q = S * v0 = Sd * sqrt(g/(2h)).

title: Projectile motion reasoning
description: Important: The solution must apply independent vertical (h = 1/2 gt^2) and horizontal (d = v0 t) motion equations.

title: Interpretation of given variables
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify h as vertical drop and d as horizontal range in the projectile equations.

title: Definition of volume flow rate
description: Important: The solution must state or correctly use Q = (cross-sectional area) * (fluid speed).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final answers should have or imply correct units (s, m/s, m³/s).

title: Incorrect time formula
description: Pitfall: Using t = d/v0 without solving the system, or using t = sqrt(h/g) (missing factor of 2).

title: Algebraic sign error
description: Pitfall: Making a sign error when combining equations, e.g., inverting the ratio g/h or h/g.

title: Misapplying flow rate formula
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula for Q, such as Q = S/t or Q = v0/h.
